podcast.title: 80s Alt-Rock Radio Inclusion
podcast.body: British indie music was among the diverse genres featured on alt-rock radio playlists in the 1980s, demonstrating the broad range of music played before the rise of grunge.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influenced by Madchester
podcast.body: Madchester music played a significant role in setting the stage for British indie music that developed over the 15 years following the Madchester era. "This was music that set the stage for much of the British indie music that was to come for the next 15 years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Madchester Influence
